crop_image_from_bbox: crop an image using center and scale parameters with optional rotation support
crop_image_with_bbox_info: crop an image and return bounding box scale and top-left corner coordinates
flip_image_and_keypoints: flip an image horizontally and permute keypoints using SMPL flip permutation
convert_smpl_to_bbox_coords: convert SMPL 3D coordinates to 2D bounding box coordinates using scale and translation
process_image_from_keypoints: process an image by cropping based on 2D keypoints and returning normalized tensor
